scene.summary: A weathered milestone leans beside the northwest mud track, where the road thins into scrub and standing rainwater.
visible_facts: A weathered stone milestone leans beside the northwest mud track.
The mud around the marker is churned with faint overlapping prints that fade into the scrub.
The track continues a short way past the stone before rainwater and brush make the next step unclear.
